title_cn: 发现北海道：自然与绝景
subtitle_en: Explore Hokkaido's Untamed Beauty in Comfort

price.note: per person (site catalog price); AUD 6100–7000; EUR 3300–3700

days_detail.title: Welcome to Japan- Arrival in Hokkaido
days_detail.activities: Welcome to Japan! Our staff awaits you at New Chitose Airport with everything needed for your journey. Enjoy a comfortable chartered taxi transfer to your hotel for check-in.

days_detail.title: A day exploring Sapporo and the charm of Otaru
days_detail.activities: Hotel breakfast Spend a full day exploring vibrant Sapporo, renowned for its spacious urban layout, abundant nature, and exceptional Hokkaido cuisine. Must-visit attractions include Odori Park, the city's central green space hosting seasonal festivals and offering stunning cityscapes; Susukino, Sapporo's largest entertainment district perfect for experiencing local nightlife and gourmet dining; and the iconic Sapporo Clock Tower, a historic landmark showcasing Hokkaido's pioneering heritage. (*Entrance fees not included) Consider extending your adventure to picturesque Otaru, a charming historic port town featuring preserved stone warehouses and romantic canals. Highlights include the famous Otaru Canal with its nostalgic stone buildings, Kitaichi Glass for exquisite handcrafted glassware, the enchanting Music Box Museum, and Sankaku Market for the freshest seafood experiences.

days_detail.title: Wildlife encounters and scenic wonders in Sounkyo Gorge
days_detail.activities: Enjoy the Hotel breakfast and checkout. Travel by chartered taxi to Asahikawa visiting Asahiyama Zoo, Hokkaido's premier wildlife park for observing natural animal behaviors up close. (*Entrance fees not included) Continue to Sounkyo Gorge in Daisetsuzan National Park, featuring dramatic cliffs, waterfalls, and seasonal landscapes. Witness the contrasting Ginga and Ryusei Falls, Sounkyo's iconic twin waterfalls offering breathtaking scenery. Transfer to hotel via chartered taxi for check-in and dinner.

days_detail.title: A scenic journey through peaks, lakes, and open skies
days_detail.activities: Enjoy the Hotel breakfast and checkout. Take chartered taxi to Kurodake Ropeway, ascending through spectacular gorge and forest views via cable car and chairlift for breathtaking mountain panoramas. (*Entrance fees not included) Enjoy free lunch in Kitami, then continue to Bihoro Pass, offering stunning overlook views of Lake Kussharo, one of Hokkaido's most iconic scenic spots. Explore Japan's largest caldera lake, where vast tranquil waters and surrounding wilderness create serene natural beauty. Return to hotel via chartered taxi for check-in and dinner.

days_detail.title: Discovering the untamed beauty of Shiretoko and Lake Mashu
days_detail.activities: Hotel breakfast Journey by chartered taxi to Shiretoko, a UNESCO World Heritage site at Hokkaido's northeastern tip, renowned for pristine wilderness, diverse wildlife, and spectacular landscapes. Key destinations include: Shiretoko Five Lakes, featuring pristine forests, serene lakes, and mountain views accessible via elevated boardwalks; Shiretoko Nature Center for wildlife education and recommended lunch spot; and Shiretoko Pass, one of the "Eight Views of Shiretoko," offering magnificent vistas of Mount Rausu and dramatic mountain scenery. Return to hotel via chartered taxi for dinner.

days_detail.title: Relaxing moments by the peaceful shores of Lake Akan
days_detail.activities: Hotel breakfast Enjoy free time exploring Lake Akan area, where rich natural beauty meets indigenous Ainu culture. Experience the serene Lake Akan cruise offering stunning views of Mount O-Akan and pristine lakeside scenery. Visit Ainu Kotan village to discover traditional culture, crafts, and performances in authentic shops and theaters. Stroll the Bokke Nature Trail through forests to witness fascinating mud volcanoes created by geothermal activity.(*Entrance fees not included) Perfect blend of natural wonders and cultural heritage. Hotel dinner

days_detail.activities: Hotel breakfast The tour ends at hotel check-out. Thank you for spending the last 7 days with our tour. We hope to see you again!

days_detail.title: Welcome to Japan- Arrival in Hokkaido
days_detail.activities: Welcome to Japan! Our staff awaits you at New Chitose Airport with everything needed for your journey. Enjoy a comfortable chartered taxi transfer to your hotel for check-in.

days_detail.title: A day exploring Sapporo and the charm of Otaru
days_detail.activities: After a breakfast served at the hotel, spend a full day exploring vibrant Sapporo, renowned for its spacious urban layout, abundant nature, and exceptional Hokkaido cuisine. Must-visit attractions include Odori Park, the city's central green space hosting seasonal festivals and offering stunning cityscapes; Susukino, Sapporo's largest entertainment district perfect for experiencing local nightlife and gourmet dining; and the iconic Sapporo Clock Tower, a historic landmark showcasing Hokkaido's pioneering heritage.(*Entrance fees not included) Consider extending your adventure to picturesque Otaru, a charming historic port town featuring preserved stone warehouses and romantic canals. Highlights include the famous Otaru Canal with its nostalgic stone buildings, Kitaichi Glass for exquisite handcrafted glassware, the enchanting Music Box Museum, and Sankaku Market for the freshest seafood experiences.

days_detail.title: A journey through Ainu culture and volcanic landscapes
days_detail.activities: Hotel breakfast and checkout. Send large luggage ahead to Hakodate for hassle-free sightseeing in Lake Toya. Full-day chartered taxi tour exploring: UPOPOY National Ainu Museum and Park for immersive cultural experiences with traditional dance and crafts; Noboribetsu Date Jidaimura, an Edo-period theme park featuring ninja performances and samurai atmosphere; dramatic Noboribetsu Hell Valley with volcanic steam vents showcasing Earth's raw power; and Showa-Shinzan Bear Ranch for close encounters with Hokkaido's iconic brown bears. (*Entrance fees not included) Transfer to hotel via chartered taxi for check-in and dinner.

days_detail.title: Relaxing by the tranquil waters of Lake Toya
days_detail.activities: After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy a leisurely day exploring Lake Toya area, Hokkaido's premier caldera lake destination renowned for stunning mountain-lake vistas and rejuvenating hot springs amid pristine natural surroundings. Recommended highlights include: Lake Toya cruise offering tranquil views of Nakajima Island and surrounding peaks from the water; Mount Usu Ropeway ascending to panoramic viewpoints overlooking the lake and dramatic volcanic landscape; and Silo Observatory, a popular scenic spot providing breathtaking views of Lake Toya and its central island and complete the day with a Hotel dinner (Entrance fees not included).

days_detail.title: Strolling through Hakodate’s bay district and sparkling night views
days_detail.activities: Breakfast served at the hotel and checkout. Travel by bus to Toya Station, then take a JR Limited Express train to Hakodate Station. Discover Hakodate, southern Hokkaido's charming port city celebrated for stunning ocean vistas, historic streetscapes, and exceptional fresh seafood. Must-visit attractions include: Kanemori Red Brick Warehouses, beautifully preserved historical buildings now housing delightful shops and cafes; scenic Bay Area strolls along the harbor showcasing Hakodate's nostalgic maritime charm; Hachiman-zaka slope offering iconic city views stretching toward the sea; and Mount Hakodate's world-renowned night panorama accessible via ropeway, considered among Japan's most spectacular evening vistas. (*Entrance fees not included) Hotel check-in

days_detail.title: The flavors and views of Hakodate at your own pace
days_detail.activities: Hotel breakfast and continue exploring Hakodate's captivating attractions: Hakodate Morning Market - Experience vibrant seafood culture with the freshest catches and authentic Hokkaido delicacies at this bustling marketplace. Goryokaku Park - Discover Japan's unique star-shaped fortress ruins offering historical insights and seasonal beauty. Ascend Goryokaku Tower for spectacular aerial views of the distinctive pentagonal layout and panoramic city vistas. Motomachi District - Stroll charming hillside streets lined with historic churches and elegant Western-style mansions, immersing yourself in Hakodate's rich cultural heritage and architectural treasures from the Meiji era. (*Entrance fees not included)

days_detail.title: Welcome to Japan- Arrival in Tokyo
days_detail.activities: Welcome to Japan! Our staff will be waiting for you at Haneda or Narita Airport. We will provide you with everything you need for this trip and escort you to the taxi/bus stand or train station. Hotel Check-in

days_detail.title: Tradition and Modern Life in Tokyo
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel This vibrant city beautifully blends traditional Japanese culture with the latest trends. The best way to experience all that Tokyo has to offer is by exploring on foot, so put on your walking shoes and get ready for an adventure!

days_detail.title: Mount Fuji Views & Lakeside Relaxation
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel After breakfast, check out and send your large luggage to Matsumoto. You can explore Mount Fuji and Ustukushigahara at your leisure. Take the chartered taxi to Mount Fuji. Enjoy the beautiful views of Mount Fuji, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that has shaped Japanese culture. After sightseeing, take the chartered taxi to Isawa Onsen. Hotel Check-in Isawa Onsen is one of the largest hot spring resorts in Yamanashi, located near the Mount Fuji area. Relax and enjoy the hotel's hot springs. Dinner at the Hotel

days_detail.title: Sacred Shrines & Scenic Highlands of Nagano
Matsumoto Castle & Traditional Streets
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel Today, let's enjoy sightseeing in Matsumoto. Matsumoto is a town known for its castle and is surrounded by mountains. The main attraction is Matsumoto Castle, a National Treasure that represents the town. This area offers a mix of history, culture, nature, and city walks. Hotel Check-in

days_detail.title: Kamikochi: The Heart of the Japanese Alps
Shirakawa-go: Thatched Roof Villages
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel Take the chartered taxi to Shirakawa-go, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This traditional farming village showcases Gassho-zukuri thatched houses designed for harsh winters, preserving ancestral wisdom. After sightseeing, take the chartered taxi to Takayama.

days_detail.title: From Mountain Towns to the Sea of Japan
The Legendary Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel After check out, travel from Dentetsu Toyama to Tateyama. This trip takes us through Chubu Sangaku National Park. The Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route connects Toyama and Nagano Prefectures. It is Japan's main mountain route. You can enjoy the beautiful Northern Alps by using different types of transportation, such as ropeways, cable cars, and buses. After sightseeing, take the chertered taxi to Yudanaka Onsen. Hotel Check-in Dinner at the Hotel

days_detail.title: Meet Japan’s Wild Monkeys in Nagano
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel After check out, take the hotel shuttle bus to visit the Monkey Park. Jigokudani Monkey Park is a special place where you can see wild Japanese macaques. The park also has nature trails where you can enjoy seasonal plants, streams, and the forest's beauty. This makes it a great spot to connect with both wildlife and nature. After your visit, take the limited express train from Yudanaka to Nagano. You have two sightseeing options: Plan A and Plan B. [Plan A] When you arrive at Nagano, enjoy lunch before taking the Shinkansen. [Plan B] Enjoy approximately two hours of free time to explore Zenko-ji Temple. Zenko-ji Temple is a historic Buddhist temple dating back over 1,400 years. In the afternoon, travel from Nagano to Tokyo by limited express train, then transfer to Shinjuku by local train. Check in at the Hotel

days_detail.title: Have fun in the friendly and relaxed neighborhoods of Tokyo
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel Ready to explore beyond Tokyo? Here are some great spots to check out. Plus, there are exciting amusement and theme parks close by for some extra fun!

days_detail.title: Sayonara, and can't wait to see you next time!
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel. The tour ends at hotel check-out. Thank you for spending the last 12 days with our tour. We hope to see you again!

Visit Shirakawa-go, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with traditional Gassho-zukuri farmhouses
Experience the stunning mountains by taking the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route.

days_detail.title: The traditions of Ama divers and the beauty of Shima
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel After you check out, take the Ise-Shima Liner to Kashikojima station. Then, take a ferry from Kashikojima Port to Wagu Port and enjoy a fresh seafood lunch at Ama Hut Satoumian, where local ama divers have long preserved their unique fishing culture. After lunch, travel by chartered taxi to Shinju no Sato, a pearl workshop, where you'll have the opportunity to harvest your own pearl. (If the workshop is closed, this visit will not be included in the itinerary.)*Experience fee not included After your visit, transfer to your hotel by chartered taxi. Hotel check-in Dinner at the hotel.

days_detail.title: From the sacred grounds of Ise to the Kumano region
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the hotel After breakfast, check out of the hotel and send your large luggage to Osaka. This lets you explore Kii-Katsuura freely. Take a local train to Ise Shrine (NAIKU), Japan's most famous shrine with about 2,000 years of history. It is a peaceful place where you can reflect as you walk along the tree-lined path. After your visit, take a kintetsu limited express to Matsusaka Station. From there, transfer to Kii-Katsuura using limited express trains. Upon arrival at Kii-Katsuura Station, walk to Katsuura port and take the shuttle boat to the hotel. Hotel check-in and Dinner at the hotel.

days_detail.title: Sacred shrines and the majestic Nachi Falls
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel After breakfast, take a chartered taxi for sightseeing. Here are some key places to visit: Kumano Hongu Taisha Shrine :The main shrine of the Kumano Sanzan, welcoming many visitors as the final stop on the pilgrimage. After sightseeing, return to the hotel by chartered taxi. Dinner at the hotel.

attractions: Umeda Sky Building / Sky Garden Observatory
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel After you check out, take the limited express train to Osaka Tennoji. Osaka is a lively city known for its busy downtown areas and varied food culture. It has many attractions, from historical sites to modern viewpoints. Hotel Check-in

days_detail.title: Welcome to Japan- Arrival in Tokyo

days_detail.title: The adventure kicks off in vibrant Tokyo
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel This vibrant city beautifully blends traditional Japanese culture with the latest trends. The best way to experience all that Tokyo has to offer is by exploring on foot, so put on your walking shoes and get ready for an adventure!

days_detail.title: Heading West by Bullet Train- The Sea God Konpira and an Onsen Stay
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel After breakfast, check out and send your large luggage to Takamatsu. You can explore Kotohira at your leisure. In the morning, travel from Tokyo to Okayama by Shinkansen, then take the limited express train to Kotohira. Kotohira is famous for the Kotohira-gu Shrine, which honors sea guardians. Climbing the stone steps may bring blessings. Explore traditional buildings and local food. Enjoy free time for sightseeing. Hotel Check-in Dinner at the Hotel Relax in the hot springs to unwind

days_detail.title: Adventure in the Hidden Iya Valley and Ritsurin Garden
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel Hotel Check-out Join a morning bus tour to Iya Valley and Oboke. Both areas feature beautiful mountains, steep gorges, and clear streams. *For tours departing between November 28 and February 25, the Iya Valley & Oboke Shuttle Bus Tour is unavailable and will be replaced with free time for independent sightseeing. In the afternoon, travel from Kotoden Kotohira to Ritsurin-Kouen and transfer to Takamatsu-chikko. We recommend exploring Takamatsu, a coastal city known for its history, art, and food. Hotel Check-in

days_detail.title: Experiencing Life on the Islands of the Seto Inland Sea
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel In the morning, travel from Takamatsu Port to Tonosho Port by ferry. Shodoshima is a quiet island in the Seto Inland Sea, known for olives and soy sauce. Local drivers provide guided taxi tours to explore the island.

days_detail.title: Island of Contemporary Art- Naoshima island
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the hotel In the morning,travel from Takamatsu Port to Miyaura Port by ferry. Naoshima Island features museums and outdoor artworks, making it great for walking and exploring. Reserve a rental bicycle in advance to get around easily. Travel back to Takamatsu Port by ferry.

days_detail.title: A Flexible Day Exploring the Setouchi Islands
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel The Seto Inland Sea is a beautiful area with unique islands full of art, nature, and history. Plan your trip carefully, as museum hours and ferry schedules vary by island.

days_detail.title: The Land of Sunshine – Okayama & Kurashiki
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel After breakfast, check out and send your large luggage to Osaka. You can explore Okayama, Himeji and Kinosaki at your leisure. In the morning, travel from Takamatsu to Okayama by limited express train. Okayama and Kurashiki are rich in history and culture. Kurashiki features charming white-walled streets, while Okayama has notable castles and gardens. In the afternoon, travel from Okayama to Himeji by Shinkansen. Hotel Check-in

days_detail.title: Himeji Castle, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and Journey to Hot Spring Town Kinosaki
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel Hotel Check-out Himeji is a beautiful castle town with rich history. Before we leave, let’s sightsee. Around noon, travel from Himeji to Kinosaki Onsen by limited express train. Enjoy a relaxing day in Kinosaki Onsen, a picturesque hot spring town with wooden hotels and willow trees. days_detail.title: Toba's Ama diving culture and the delicious seafood
days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel Hotel Check-out In the morning, travel from Nagoya to Toba by Sightseeing Limited Express "SHIMAKAZE" or another limited express train. Toba is a port town in Mie Prefecture. It is known for its beautiful sea and island views and for its Ama diving culture. From Toba, take the shuttle bus to Hachiman Kamado. Hachiman Kamado is an Ama hut where you can enjoy a meal while Ama divers share stories about their fishing experiences and lives. You will enjoy delicious Ise seafood for lunch! After lunch, take the shuttle bus back to Toba, then travel from Toba to Kashikojima by limited express train. Hotel Check-in Dinner at the Hotel

days_detail.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel In the morning, move to Koyasan by limited express train. Koyasan is a mountain town recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is surrounded by cedar forests and has deep ties to Japanese Buddhism. Kobo Daishi Kukai practiced asceticism here for over 1,200 years. In the evening, return to Osaka by limited express train.
